nodes.description: uint256 public Refundpot; pot used to refund losers 0.1 ether each
uint256 public Jackpot; 1% of P3D dividends accumulated for the 1-in-1000 jackpot
mapping(address => uint256) private playerVault; withdrawable balances of survivors
mapping(uint256 => Stage) public stages; per-round player slots, blocknumber and players
mapping(uint256 => address) public RefundWaitingLine; queue of losers awaiting refund
mapping(uint256 => address) public Loser; recorded sacrifice per finalized stage
uint256 public numberOfStages; stage counter
uint256 private numberOfFinalizedStages; number of already resolved rounds
uint256 public NextInLine; head index of the refund queue
uint256 public NextAtLineEnd; tail index of the refund queue
mapping(address => uint256) public ETHtoP3Dbymasternode; ETH reserved to buy P3D via masternode/affiliate
uint256 public winningsPerRound = 0.185 ether; payout to each survivor
mapping(address => string) public Vanity; player display strings
HourglassInterface constant p3dContract; external P3D (Hourglass) dividend contract
function Expand(address masternode) public; flushes stored ETH into P3D buy
function DivsToRefundpot() public; harvests P3D dividends into Refundpot/Jackpot and pays SPASM
function DonateToLosers() public payable; adds msg.value to Refundpot
function Payoutnextrefund() public; pays 0.1 ether to the head of the refund queue
function changevanity(string van, address masternode) public payable; sets Vanity and buys P3D for a masternode
function offerAsSacrifice(address MN) external payable; external payable entry that joins a stage
function offerAsSacrificeFromVault(address MN) external; joins a stage paying from playerVault
function withdraw() external hasEarnings; zeroes vault then transfers to msg.sender
function acceptOffer(address MN) private; writes player into the current stage
function tryFinalizeStage() public; determines the sacrifice from blockhash and distributes winnings
function allocateSurvivorWinnings(address sacrifice) private; credits winningsPerRound to survivors
function invalidateStage(uint256 stageIndex) private; refunds OFFER_SIZE to both players
constructor(); creates the first Stage
function() external payable {}; plain payable fallback with no logic
function previousstagedata() public view; UI getter for the last finalized stage
function currentstagedata() public view; UI getter for the current stage
function checkstatus() public view; indicates whether a stage can be finalized
function Refundlineinfo() public view; UI getter for the refund queue and pot
function jackpotinfo() public view; returns the Jackpot size
caller-controlled address used as player, payee and vault key
p3dContract.buy.value(amt)(masternode) external payable call to a fixed address from Expand/changevanity
p3dContract.withdraw() external call executed before Refundpot/Jackpot state update
SPASM_.disburse.value(base)() external call sending ETH to the profit-sharing contract
RefundWaitingLine[NextInLine].transfer(0.1 ether) external send to a queue member
msg.sender.transfer(amount) external ETH send in withdraw
sacrifice.transfer(Jackpot) external ETH send during jackpot win in tryFinalizeStage
Unchecked arithmetic playerVault[survivor] += winningsPerRound in allocateSurvivorWinnings
Unchecked arithmetic Refundpot -= 0.1 ether in Payoutnextrefund
address masternode parameter of Expand
address MN parameter of acceptOffer (P3D attribution address)
string van parameter of changevanity
uint256 stageIndex parameter of invalidateStage
address sacrifice parameter of allocateSurvivorWinnings
uint256 amt local holding ETHtoP3Dbymasternode before the buy
uint256 dividends local returned by p3dContract.myDividends(true)
address sacrifice local derived from blockhash in tryFinalizeStage
uint256 jackpot local (blockhash % 1000) deciding the jackpot win
uint256 amount local holding playerVault[msg.sender] in withdraw

edges.reason: msg.sender is written as the new player into the current stage
withdraw uses playerVault[msg.sender] as the transferred amount
msg.sender is the recipient of the external transfer in withdraw
msg.sender is the key written in Vanity and the fee payer
msg.sender offers himself as sacrifice in the current stage
msg.sender vault balance is debited when offering from vault
offerAsSacrifice calls acceptOffer
offerAsSacrifice calls tryFinalizeStage after accepting the offer
offerAsSacrificeFromVault calls acceptOffer
offerAsSacrificeFromVault calls tryFinalizeStage
withdraw calls tryFinalizeStage before paying out
tryFinalizeStage calls allocateSurvivorWinnings for the sacrifice
tryFinalizeStage calls invalidateStage when the blockhash is unavailable
acceptOffer writes slotXplayer, players and blocknumber of the current stage
acceptOffer reads stages[numberOfStages - 1] as the current stage
tryFinalizeStage reads stageToFinalize and sets finalized = true
tryFinalizeStage stores the chosen sacrifice in Loser
tryFinalizeStage appends the sacrifice to RefundWaitingLine
NextAtLineEnd++ is an unchecked counter increment
tryFinalizeStage credits 0.005 ether of P3D buys to the stage masternodes
tryFinalizeStage adds 0.005 ether to Refundpot
tryFinalizeStage pays out and resets Jackpot on a jackpot win
tryFinalizeStage executes sacrifice.transfer(Jackpot)
tryFinalizeStage increments numberOfFinalizedStages
allocateSurvivorWinnings performs unchecked playerVault[survivor] += winningsPerRound
allocateSurvivorWinnings reads the winningsPerRound payout constant
invalidateStage performs unchecked playerVault[player] += OFFER_SIZE
Expand forwards stored ETH via p3dContract.buy
Expand reads and zeroes ETHtoP3Dbymasternode[masternode]
changevanity buys P3D using the accumulated masternode ETH
changevanity writes Vanity[msg.sender]
changevanity adds msg.value to ETHtoP3Dbymasternode and resets it
DivsToRefundpot calls p3dContract.withdraw before crediting state
DivsToRefundpot calls SPASM_.disburse with 1% of the dividends
DivsToRefundpot credits 94% of the base to Refundpot
DivsToRefundpot credits 5% of the base to Jackpot
DonateToLosers adds msg.value to Refundpot
Payoutnextrefund performs unchecked Refundpot -= 0.1 ether
Payoutnextrefund transfers 0.1 ether to RefundWaitingLine[NextInLine]
NextInLine++ is an unchecked counter increment
transfer to msg.sender gives the caller control during withdraw
transfer to a queued loser gives control back during Payoutnextrefund
Jackpot transfer to the sacrifice gives control back during tryFinalizeStage
SPASM_.disburse external call happens before Refundpot/Jackpot are credited
p3dContract.withdraw external call happens before the dividend accounting
p3dContract.buy external call can execute third-party code during Expand
p3dContract.buy external call can execute third-party code during changevanity

normalization_plan.reason: masternode parameter only selects the P3D attribution address of Expand
MN parameter is stored into stage.setMN inside acceptOffer
van parameter is written into Vanity by changevanity
stageIndex parameter only selects the stage invalidated by invalidateStage
sacrifice parameter only discriminates the survivor loop in allocateSurvivorWinnings
amt local is the exact value forwarded by the p3dContract.buy call
dividends local is the harvested amount driving DivsToRefundpot accounting
sacrifice local is the address chosen and paid inside tryFinalizeStage
jackpot local is the blockhash modulo used by the jackpot branch of tryFinalizeStage
amount local is the exact value sent by msg.sender.transfer in withdraw
